text:
Ava (People Ops): quick thread to capture follow-ups from today's all-hands Q&A about reviews, comp, and benefits. dropping the short answers + links here for folks who asked.

Omar: thanks! can you confirm the review cutoff?

Ava (People Ops): cutoff for self + manager reviews = June 7 23:59 PT. Calibration is June 10-14.

Chloe: what happens if a manager misses the manager-review deadline?

Ava (People Ops): we escalate after 48h. Managers must notify their manager & people-ops with reasons; we'll provide a 3-day soft extension in extenuating cases.

Lina (Eng Manager): on promotions, are managers expected to submit impact metrics? any required format?

Ava (People Ops): yes please include 3-5 measurable outcomes + product/metric linkage. sample snippet in the packet template:

```
Impact summary (3 bullets):
- Reduced p99 latency by 35% on /generate (Q1)
- Owned rollout of caching layer saving ~$12k/mo
- Mentored two L3 engineers to L4
```

Link: <https://confluence.internal/redwood/promotion-packet-template>

Ben (Finance): band refresh conversation: finance + people ops will evaluate market comp the week after calibration. any approved adjustments will be communicated before end of quarter. no immediate action this week.

Omar: are off-cycle raises allowed for retention?

Ben (Finance): off-cycle raises are allowed but require business case + Sr leadership sign-off. narrow use (retention/critical hires). submit via the form in the manager kit.

Raj (CEO): quick context: we want to keep strong merit cycles but be pragmatic on retention. expect tighter approvals for high-cost moves.

Chloe: benefits question 9k - was open enrollment timing changed?

Ava (People Ops): open enrollment is the same window (Oct). but we are adding a new fertility benefit pilot (eligibility details coming in July).

Lina (Eng Manager): appeals process after calibration? what is the timeline?

Ava (People Ops): appeals open for 72 hours after outcome emails. manager endorsement required + written rationale. appeals reviewed by panel (People Ops + 2 senior managers). aim to resolve within 10 business days.

Omar: can managers see calibration notes?

Ava (People Ops): managers get a calibrated outcome + brief rationale for any changes to their packet. detailed panel notes are internal to calibration to protect candid feedback.

Chloe: will rubric changes be retroactive? there was talk of "examples doc" in the call.

Ava (People Ops): rubric v2 examples doc is active for this cycle. If a packet was started under v1, managers should map criteria to v2 in a short addendum. Link: <https://confluence.internal/redwood/leveling-examples-v2>

HR Bot: Reminder: self-review guide & checklist: <https://confluence.internal/redwood/self-review-guide> - due 06/07 23:59 PT.

Lina (Eng Manager): can you drop the manager office hours? I have a packet Q.

Ava (People Ops): office hours Thursday 9am PT — calendar: <https://calendar.google.com/event?id=peopleops-officehours-2026-06-04>. If you can't make it, DM me and I'll triage.

Chloe: appreciate the clarity. also, is there a template for mapping v1->v2? makes life easier.

Ava (People Ops): yes, mapping template: <https://confluence.internal/redwood/v1-to-v2-mapping-template> - managers can attach to the packet.

Omar: tiny ask  can we get an anonymous survey after outcomes to capture perceptions?

Ava (People Ops): yes planning a short pulse survey within 2 weeks of calibration emails. voluntary and anonymous.

Raj (CEO): thanks Ava + team for running a clear process. feedback welcome.

HR Bot: Reactions: :thumbsup: x8, :white_check_mark: x3

Ava (People Ops): final note: if anyone needs help wording impact statements or pulling metrics, sign up for 1:1 slots on my calendar. we'll also share a recorded walkthrough of packet best practices after office hours.
